# PrintfScanfArguments

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `PrintfScanfArgumentsInspection`

The `printf`/`scanf` family takes as many value arguments as the format string
has conversions. A missing or extra argument silently produces wrong output
(or an `ArgumentCountError` in PHP 8), and a stray `%` makes the format
invalid.

## Example

```php{11,12,13,14,15,16,20}
<?php
class Report
{
    const ROW = '%s: %d%%';
    public static $line = '%-10s|%5.1f';
    private $head = '%%title%% %s';

    public function render($fh, $name, $total, $raw)
    {
        $fmt = '%%%s=%x';
        echo sprintf($fmt, $name);
        fprintf($fh, self::ROW, $name, $total, $raw);
        echo sprintf(self::$line, $name);
        echo sprintf($this->head);
        echo sprintf('50 %, total %s', $name);
        sscanf($raw, '%d-%d', $a);

        echo sprintf('%05.2f %s', $total, $name);
        echo sprintf("%2\$'#8s %1\$s", $name, $total);
        echo sprintf('%2$s %1$s', $name);
        [$x, $y] = sscanf($raw, '%d-%d');
        $parts = fscanf($fh, '%s %s');
        store(sscanf($raw, '%s'));
        sscanf($raw, '%*d %s', $only);
        sscanf($raw, '%[a-z]', $word);
        printf('%s %s', ...$pair);
        echo sprintf($unknown, $name);
        echo sprintf("Hi $name %s");
    }

    public function grow()
    {
        $tpl = 'id=%d';
        $tpl .= ' name=%s';
        return sprintf($tpl, 1, 'x');
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 11: This call needs 3 argument(s) in total.</li>
<li>line 12: This call needs 4 argument(s) in total.</li>
<li>line 13: This call needs 3 argument(s) in total.</li>
<li>line 14: This call needs 2 argument(s) in total.</li>
<li>line 15: Malformed format string.</li>
<li>line 16: This call needs 4 argument(s) in total.</li>
<li>line 20: This call needs 3 argument(s) in total.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "PrintfScanfArguments": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore PrintfScanfArguments

/**
 * @noinspection PrintfScanfArgumentsInspection
 */
```
